method.description: free text: the method vocabulary is owned by the advisory lint rules `ac-verification-method` / `vc-validation-method` (four ISO 29148 methods); the census counts 1,141 distinct spellings over 20,881 cells, of which the four the lint rule admits account for 13,258, and a schema that closed them would reject the corpus it describes.

annotation.description: free text: the parenthesized remainder of the cell, verbatim, so the split loses nothing the author wrote.

description:
A verification or validation cell split by the `typed-table` mapping.
`Test (TC-035, TC-036)` is `method: Test`, `annotation: "TC-035, TC-036"`,
`testRefs: [TC-035, TC-036]`. `annotation` carries the text between the first
`(` and the last `)` verbatim, so no byte of the authored cell is dropped; a
cell without parentheses is `method` alone with `testRefs: []` and no
`annotation`.
